prior_review.disposition: Preserved unchanged; this delta records only the subsequent fixes and review.

scope.asset: CALCE CS2-35 capacity measurement reconstruction only
reviewed_changes: cached-record digest and cached source-member binding
exact duplicate alias and conflicting-signal handling
uncertain occurrence count excludes exact duplicate aliases

reviewed_conclusions.cached_record_provenance: Protocol pins the cached records SHA256 and source-member SHA256; runner verifies the cache digest and checks schema_receipt_server member_sha256 against the pinned member hash before reuse.
reviewed_conclusions.output_collision_safety: Per-file gzip caches use exclusive create mode xt. The measurement table and reconstruction summary also use exclusive create mode x.
reviewed_conclusions.duplicate_policy: Fingerprint uses the full cycle raw signal while excluding only source_row. Exact aliases remain in the asset, are marked separately, and are excluded from valid capacity counts. Different signals sharing discharge end datetime and source cycle are marked UNCERTAIN and have capacity and SOH cleared. The first conflicting record remains indexed, so each subsequent distinct signal at that key is also compared and invalidated.
reviewed_conclusions.count_reconciliation: uncertain_occurrences counts only UNCERTAIN rows; exact duplicate aliases have a separate count.
reviewed_conclusions.scientific_limit: Accepted values are sampled-signal consistent measurements. Absolute calibration and exact hardware cutoff remain unknown. Whole-life first-passage EOL and native-cycle RUL remain blocked while inter-file continuity is unverified.

conclusion: The reviewed delta resolves the two blockers from the prior receipt and introduces no new blocking issue. This is a pre-GO code review only; no capacity asset or experimental result was produced.
